decisions.statement: A page type opens only to a person with an access naming the page type.
An access stating `all` names every page type.
Only an access of the page type kind opens a page type.
An access opens only the deed that access names.
A caller no session names is the reader nobody signed in as.
That reader holds the accesses that reader's own page is named by.
A grant is read from the access pages rather than compiled in.
Access pages that went unread open nothing.
A decision carries why the decision refused.
No page type is named here.

definition: whether the person a caller represents may read or write a page type
